column3: Full adaptive edge-query tradeoff with arbitrary runtime; the record already supplies the greedy-plus-bruteforce baseline. Reproducing that baseline or a fixed k would not answer the extremal question.
Related sequence b_j is unconstrained; a constant sequence would be a wording trick. Cayley edge-cut counts are routine and do not resolve the requested useful combinatorial comparison.
Math-communication resource and infrastructure agenda, not a quantified mathematical claim with a proof endpoint.
Uniform forbidden-induced-cycle classification over all finite nonabelian simple groups and all n; small-group graph checks cannot cover Lie-rank and field-size families.
Exceptional Lie-type automorphism conjugate generation and exact maxima; needs uniform structural group theory, not testing a few automorphisms.
Baer-Suzuki invariant over complete classes; BS is not defined in the literal record. Finite boundary values do not eliminate the all-class quantifier in either part.

Primary Update 2.66 explicitly reports independence from set-theoretic axioms, attributed to Hinkkanen. No ZFC construction can be claimed from transfinite recursion alone; unpublished underlying argument not independently revalidated.

Primary Update 3.23 explicitly gives Govorov's existing bound (constant 1 below threshold, 2^7/r above 2^8). Already answered in the same source; no new covering lemma credit. Underlying 1968 proof not inspected.

All dimensions and all numbers of foci, sharp maximal-volume configurations plus connected-set radius 2. Source already records the m=2 result and failure of the ball extremizer in dimension3; no small-case credit.

Literal analytic-only statement omits the bounded-function hypothesis: lambda+Az makes every positive universal radius fail. The same source prints the omission and Bombieri's nonzero radii, so this is a domain correction, not a discovery. Intended sharp small-lambda Bohr radius not solved.
Coefficient maxima over every univalent degree-n polynomial and exact tail cutoff for arbitrary n. Testing low degrees or coefficient estimates does not determine the required sequence of extrema.

Sharp harmonic Koebe radius and supremum a2; source already supplies the harmonic Koebe extremizer and close-to-convex case. That example only bounds one direction and cannot prove all normalized harmonic univalent maps.
Exact optimal L-infinity conjugate component for every BMO function; existence follows from Fefferman but optimization and factoring conjecture remain beyond a cheap norm estimate.

Classification of all compact sets in C^n by equality of Shilov and hull boundaries; generic polynomially convex examples do not constitute the requested classification. Printed illustrative wording is itself suspect; no wording credit.

An omega1-indexed cofinal strict asymptotic scale of summable monotone sequences; countable diagonalization proves neither cofinality across all sequences nor independence of CH. Update7.62 supplies no resolution; related2.66 is explicitly set-theoretic.

Primary Update8.6 already gives Korenblum-type necessary and sufficient entropy criteria with differing constants for fixed p, and exact existence criterion for some p. This meets the record's alternative nontrivial-converse request already; full fixed-p characterization not certified here.

Topological-order enumeration is a tautological characterization, not a good one. Closest 2026 successor treats necessary parity/source/sink conditions and special graph families; no cheap all-graph mechanism or complete resolution of all three questions.

Simultaneous lower and upper constraints and cost<=OPT for arbitrary matroids are essential. Existing one-sided Delta-1 and two-sided 2Delta-1 bounds cannot be silently substituted for the requested two-sided Delta-1.
Exact minimum over all plane graphs for each face girth; a coloring of one graph or the supplied 2<=p(5)<=4 bounds does not close even the first case.

Polynomial optimization of a sum of partition edit distances for arbitrary k. Computing one distance by a join/refinement formula is routine and does not optimize the median; brute enumeration violates the requested complexity.

Uniform decay of infinitely many negative subharmonic components across every annulus radius. The known power-summability versus exponential example gap needs analytic structure, not a finite component sample.
Coupling-time exponential tail arbitrarily close to the exact Neumann spectral gap for every acute triangle. Merely almost-sure coupling or special symmetric triangles does not establish efficiency.

Nondegenerate distributional scaling and stabilization in random recursive subdivision; requires control of optimizing paths under all future refinements. Simulation would not supply the scaling theorem.

Free-boundary Gaussian free field needs normalization of its zero mode; full metric/geodesic scaling limits and dimensions are deep even after fixing it. Repairing normalization or proving only corner intersection is not the full multi-part scope.

Find the relationship is not a single inequality; numerical plots and crossing tables are motivation, not a quantified theorem. Need primary hypotheses and a sharp proposed relation before proof investment.
Exact primitive Vassiliev dimension in every degree. Source already tabulates small degrees; another finite diagram rank or known generating-series identity is not the all-degree answer.

Hidden-strata cancellation refers to three preceding constructions absent from the record. Rephrasing equivalences or assuming anomaly vanishing would leave the core configuration-space proof unresolved.

Two-loop polynomial for a tangle defined by a missing Figure12; full Kontsevich tangle-to-knot transformation needs recovered diagram conventions. Generic cabling formulas alone cannot certify this literal construction.

Uniform asymptotic quantum-invariant degree formula over flat-connection components, including singular/degenerate cases. Source explicitly warns about nondegeneracy; exploiting an omitted qualifier or checking one manifold is ineligible.

A complex structure/holomorphic interpolation across all Dehn fillings needs compatibility with each knot in every manifold. Arbitrary injection of a countable set in C discards the prescribed analytic continuation.

Minimal modular extensions with essential uniqueness and relation between resulting TQFTs. Quantum-double existence in the record already is a weaker extension; it does not settle minimality, uniqueness or anomalies.
All-degree connected closed-Jacobi-diagram dimensions; low-degree tables already present. A finite rank computation or a parameter instance would not solve the generating classification.

Arrow-diagram construction of the full LMO invariant requires all relations and invariance under moves. Translating a few diagrams or restating a known finite-type equivalence is not a new complete construction.

Record itself flags Habiro's extension as a potential existing solution. Must compare the actual cohomology-refined invariant before investing; no full-scope new mechanism supplied here, and no primary-body clearance claimed.

Needs an effective shadow-diagram condition including alternating knots and a rigorous volume lower bound. Arbitrary descriptive conditions or a bound zero would be wording tricks; no substantive mechanism survived statement screening.

All graded pieces and all g of Torelli Malcev Lie algebra as Sp modules; a presentation for g>6 is already recorded but extracting uniform irreducible factors is the hard representation-theoretic task.

Canonical points via symmetry and uniqueness of maximal nilpotent automorphism surfaces in arbitrary genus. A genus without such a group or a familiar symmetric surface would exploit wording and not establish a useful uniform canonical construction.

Needs a finitely presented subgroup of a mapping class group with infinitely many conjugacy classes of finite subgroups. Pullback from Sp need not preserve finite presentation; the source already proposes that approach.

Density d and dlog require the omitted ambient growth measure and generating set. Exponential growth of Torelli does not imply zero relative density; the literal d(Ig)=0 fragment is not a cheap proof target.

Exact type-F finiteness length of Torelli for arbitrary genus; finite generation and supplied upper bounds do not settle higher finiteness. This includes difficult finite-presentation questions, not a finite CW count.
Infinitely many independent rational homology cycles for both Torelli and Johnson kernel. The displayed H1 computation is already known and supplies only finitely many classes at fixed genus.

Integral abelianizations of all level mapping class groups. Finiteness from Hain/McCarthy does not determine torsion or all levels; likely successor literature must precede any attempt, no ordinary rediscovery credit.
Finite generation of the full minus-eigenspace homology with 2 inverted, not just a degree or homotopy-dimensional bound. Steinness of a related space does not imply the requested finite generation.

Direct simple representatives for stable mapping class torsion classes require a concrete target class and geometric construction. Known stable cohomology or a new notation for existing classes is not enough.

Generators of handlebody intersections with Torelli/Johnson kernel for arbitrary genus; the record embeds this in discussion rather than a standalone numbered assertion. Ambient generators need not generate an intersection.
Broad monodromy program including fundamental-group restrictions, hard Lefschetz and Seiberg-Witten; no single full-scope assertion to resolve. Reusing one listed constraint would be routine.

Converse refers to an omitted extension theorem and removes the free-base assumption. Needs uniform hyperbolicity/combination theory; checking free or cyclic cases would retain the excluded hypothesis.

One closed hyperbolic4-manifold with obstruction surviving every finite cover. Source's Davis parity obstruction is explicitly only for the manifold itself; it cannot establish virtual nonsymplecticity.

Every homomorphism Aut(F_n)->extended surface mapping class for all n>=4 and genus>=1. Torsion restrictions in source rule out some genera but not all; no faithful-embedding argument solves the finite-image question.

Requires unbounded least-preimage/totient ratio along infinitely many distinct totients. Large n/phi(n) for chosen n does not lower-bound all competing preimages; finite totient sweeps and smooth-family checks cannot supply the result.
